subject.title: Cron script state is lost on manual, catch-up, and crash-recovery paths

question: Does https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/111292 correctly preserve successful script state across manual, startup catch-up, and crash-recovery paths on the current `main` base?
rationale: The issue is protected for maintainer handling and its linked candidate changes persistence and recovery semantics across several cron execution boundaries; source-level acceptance of that repair cannot be safely inferred from the issue report alone.

options.title: Review and land the linked repair
options.body: Confirm the shared state-application and task-ledger recovery contracts on the current base, then merge the PR so GitHub closes this issue.

options.title: Request a narrower repair
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for focused changes or tests if the PR does not prove every affected execution and recovery boundary.
